top_signals.title: EU Eyes Winter LNG Buys as Storage Hits Near Two-Decade Low
top_signals.summary: The European Union is optimistic that winter liquefied natural gas imports will help offset inventories that are at their lowest level for this time of year in almost two decades after the Iran war drove up prices and disrupted summer stockpiling.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
